story: A 13-rider breakaway was quickly caught before the first climb, after which Fábio Costa attacked solo. He was reeled in after the climb before four riders escaped from the reduced peloton. Artem Nych, Alexis Guerin and Adrià Pericas remained, with Pericas winning the sprint and Guerin retaining the GC lead.
